Limescale is a common problem in many households, forming when water rich in minerals such as calcium and magnesium evaporates. As this process occurs, the excess minerals leave behind a hard, white deposit known as limescale. This buildup can cause a range of issues, from clogged pipes and appliances to more serious health problems. For instance, if you live in an area with particularly hard water, it’s not uncommon for limescale to accumulate inside your kettle or coffee maker.
